The cheapest five-star book in the Mystery category is **The Girl You Lost**, at **£12.29**.

The category has 32 books across two pages, and I checked both. Six of them are rated five stars:

- The Girl You Lost: £12.29
- The Silkworm (Cormoran Strike #2): £23.05
- What Happened on Beale Street (Secrets of the South Mysteries #2): £25.37
- A Time of Torment (Charlie Parker #14): £48.35
- The Bachelor Girl's Guide to Murder (Herringford and Watts Mysteries #1): £52.30

The page-2 listing (12 books, last one "1st to Die") is the last page, since it has no "next" link. I read both pages from the listings.

My tab (t3) is still open on page 2 of the Mystery category. Partway through, another agent's navigation sent that tab to Women's Fiction. I reloaded Mystery and re-read it, so the figures above are all from Mystery pages. I didn't touch the other tabs.

agents.answer:
The order was submitted, and httpbin.org/post echoed back the data it received:

- **Customer name:** Ada Lovelace
- **Telephone:** 555-0100
- **Email:** ada@example.com
- **Size:** Large
- **Toppings:** Bacon and Extra Cheese
- **Delivery time:** 19:45
- **Delivery instructions:** Ring twice

The result page is still open in my tab (t1).

Partway through, the browser's active tab switched to another agent's tab. A few of my first commands (the first three fills and some checks) may have run in that tab instead of mine. I couldn't tell which page they hit, so I didn't verify or undo anything there. I then switched back to t1, set every field again, and checked the form values before submitting.

tool_input.command: S=$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task); echo $S; agent-browser --session $S open https://httpbin.org/forms/post; agent-browser --session $S snapshot -i

A="agent-browser --session task-61c4ae1519f1"; $A fill @e2 "Ada Lovelace"; $A fill @e3 "555-0100"; $A fill @e4 "ada@example.com"; $A check @e7; $A check @e8; $A check @e9; $A fill @e12 "Ring twice"; $A click @e14; $A type @e14 "07"; $A type @e15 "45"; $A type @e16 "PM"; $A snapshot -i

leakingCommands.command: agent-browser --session task-61c4ae1519f1 tab; agent-browser --session task-61c4ae1519f1 snapshot -i

agents.answer:
The order is complete. The final page, https://www.saucedemo.com/checkout-complete.html, shows "Thank you for your order!"

I logged in as standard_user and sorted the products by price from low to high. The cart held the Sauce Labs Backpack and the Sauce Labs Bike Light. I checked out as Ada Lovelace, postal code 10001, and finished the order.

The tab is still open as t2. Other agents were using the browser, so I stayed in my own tab and switched back to it before each step. In a few places I used page scripts or direct URLs instead of clicks, because clicks were landing unreliably. I used only the agent-browser tool.

tool_input.command: S=$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task); echo $S; agent-browser --session $S open https://www.saucedemo.com && agent-browser --session $S snapshot -i
B="agent-browser --session task-8e1ae01a3d8c"; $B fill @e5 standard_user && $B fill @e6 secret_sauce && $B click @e4 && $B wait --url "**/inventory.html" && $B snapshot -i
A="agent-browser --session task-8e1ae01a3d8c"; $A tab t2 >/dev/null; $A fill @e27 standard_user; $A fill @e28 secret_sauce; $A click @e26; $A tab t2 >/dev/null; $A snapshot -i

agent-browser --session task-8e1ae01a3d8c tab new https://www.saucedemo.com; agent-browser --session task-8e1ae01a3d8c tab; agent-browser --session task-8e1ae01a3d8c snapshot -i
